approval_scope: G3B adaptive evaluator input v1 only
review_scope: Design metadata only. No executable schema, adaptive payload, adapter, trajectory, or full G3B revalidation.

proposed_schema.name: G3BAdaptiveEvaluatorInputV1
proposed_schema.representation: Flat closed discriminated union of four object variants keyed only by claim_family. Field groups are design roles, not nested payload objects.
proposed_schema.variant_expansion_rule: For each variant, required and allowed keys are exactly validation_fields + always_required_evaluator_fields + required_permission_fields. All domains apply, narrowed by that variant's claim_family and claim_universality literals. No other keys permitted.
cross_field_invariants: claim_universality = universal iff claim_family = universal; otherwise bounded
proof_supports_claim = true implies proof_available = true on every branch
authority_valid = true implies authority_present = true on permission branch
non_invariants: requested_tool and record_tool need not match: mismatch is valid evaluator data, not a malformed payload
schema_valid = false, provenance_complete = false, duplicate_lineage = true, and tool_permission = unknown remain admissible data when independently sourced
Missing source evidence is not a false boolean or an unknown tool permission value
proposed_schema.typescript_proposal: Four distinct literal-discriminated object members with common envelope and six always-present fields. Use optional never properties for permission-only keys on non-permission members, with exactOptionalPropertyTypes, or an exactness helper if that compiler option cannot be changed without cross-arm impact. Runtime closed-object validation must reject present undefined properties and extra keys regardless of TypeScript structural assignability. Do not change repository compiler flags in this phase.
proposed_schema.schema_encoding_proposal: A future schema can encode four oneOf closed object variants using the exact expansion above; no overlapping fallback branch, defaults, coercion, or property stripping. This review metadata is not a registered or executable schema.

source_resolution.identity_only_basis: Prior field-source review identifies 32 instrument_validation identities without complete semantic sources. No partition or holdout data is opened for this review.

provenance_complete_proposal.true_evidence: An independently frozen candidate evidence ledger satisfies every obligation in a separately approved semantic completeness policy; each record is uniquely bound and hash-verified.
provenance_complete_proposal.false_evidence: The same independently bound ledger explicitly records a known unsatisfied completeness obligation under that policy.
provenance_complete_proposal.unknown_or_missing: Fail closed before evaluation; neither true nor false may be self-asserted by the payload.
provenance_complete_proposal.transport_distinction: Integrity of the input's source and identity must pass even when semantic provenance_complete is explicitly false. Do not conflate these two gates.

schema_valid_analysis.human_review_option: B: derive from a separately identified evidence object's validation using a frozen validator and schema, only after human approval establishes the intended subject and semantic equivalence. Record result and references before constructing evaluator input.

order.checks: Read only an approved local non-holdout identity artifact; require exact case_id and fixture_id. Missing, duplicate or ambiguous identity blocks.
Resolve each active field from a frozen source or approved literal/derivation. No unresolved semantic field, output-dependent lookup, default or nearest-match binding.
Require experiment, fixture, historical case fingerprint, contract version, human decision commit, approved local artifact hashes and per-field binding evidence. Resolve to exactly one source record.

Future implementation only: construct the exact flat branch from resolved source fields. Reject undeclared source input keys; do not strip, fill, normalize or repair. Unknown claim_family blocks immediately.

Validate literal partition/synthetic, exact primitive domains, finite bounded numbers, no null/undefined/coercion/extra keys or duplicate JSON keys. Envelope validation has no evaluator semantic authority.
Use only the existing iff rule on source-resolved claim_family. Validate supplied universality; reject mismatches without overwriting. Check proof_supports_claim implies proof_available.

Require all six evaluator fields on every branch. Require all eight permission keys iff claim_family = permission; forbid their presence on other branches. Validate authority_valid implies authority_present on permission. No hidden branch classifier.

Hash the entire immutable validated input using the reviewed canonical mechanics. Compare with an independently frozen expected digest and exact case_id + fixture_id binding. Never self-approve a newly computed hash.

Only after every prior gate passes and implementation/phase authority permits invocation. Use the same immutable validated bytes/values; no intervening mutation or reread of mutable sources. This review authorizes no invocation.

validation_boundary.failure_records: Local review-only diagnostic containing stage and reason; not a governed verdict or comparative observation.
validation_boundary.snapshot_policy: Read/hash source bytes once, parse that same snapshot, bind each field to it, freeze validated input until evaluation to avoid time-of-check/time-of-use drift.

payload_fingerprint.name: adaptive_candidate_payload_fingerprint
payload_fingerprint.scope: Complete approved G3BAdaptiveEvaluatorInputV1: validation envelope, six always-required evaluator fields, and eight permission fields only on permission variant
payload_fingerprint.canonical_mechanics: package.ts canonical(): recursively sorted object keys, ordered arrays, JSON.stringify primitives and finite numbers; SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON without a trailing newline
payload_fingerprint.reuse_entrypoint: caseFingerprint(value) already exports these canonical hash mechanics; a proposed adaptive-named wrapper may delegate without changing the historical function or algorithm. No wrapper implemented here.
payload_fingerprint.mechanics_gap: No new canonical algorithm required for the bounded flat primitive payload. Existing hash helper alone is not a validator: reject non-finite numbers, null, undefined, non-JSON objects and duplicate JSON keys first. Negative zero follows existing JSON.stringify semantics as 0; do not introduce new normalization.
payload_fingerprint.external_binding: An independently approved, byte-hashed source manifest must bind the required tuple plus contract version and historical fingerprint. A payload hash alone proves neither identity nor source truth.
payload_fingerprint.expected_digest_source: Future independently frozen source/binding artifact, not the evaluator or candidate's self-computed digest

provenance_contract.human_decision_commit: 141c879; resolve to full immutable commit identity and verify referenced decision bytes
provenance_contract.fixture_requirement: Exact explicitly approved non-holdout fixture identity; do not infer fixture_id from case_id or runtime's first fixture selection
provenance_contract.source_artifact: Explicit local allowlisted immutable artifact; reject network paths, path escape and unapproved partitions
provenance_contract.source_artifact_hash: SHA-256 of exact raw artifact bytes, not reserialized JSON

required: per-field source locators or frozen literal/derivation references
candidate_binding_evidence.field_sources: For every active field: identify source artifact/hash and exact location, or literal/rule reference with dependencies. Multi-artifact sources need hashes for every dependency.
candidate_binding_evidence.ambiguity_policy: Reject zero or multiple matching records; no source-less semantic field and no silently selected match

provenance_contract.integrity_not_truth: Hash and binding establish provenance integrity, not semantic truth or operational authority. Independent approved evidence semantics remain necessary.
